text:
Maya (Partner Marketing): Hey team — Aegis + Skyline sent the final asset pack. Need design + legal + ops sign-off by EOD Friday. Files: aegis-skyline-solution-brief-v3.pdf, skyline-hero-4x5.png, logos.zip :calendar:
Jamal (Design): Quick pass — hero crop looks off on mobile. Can we get a 3:4 crop and the raw PSD? Also the Aegis+Skyline lockup spacing is too tight. I'll drop a mock in ~1h. :wrench:
design-bot: uploaded: /files/1719551234/hero-raw-source.psd
Marina (Legal): Received. Aegis provided PNG-only lockup; we need SVG + signed logo usage form. Their gradient mark conflicts with our brand guidelines — request a flat color variant. cc @Aegis PM (Kai)
Aegis PM (Kai): We actually have the SVGs — looks like an older alt lockup was used by mistake. Sending correct SVGs and the signed form now.
Samir (Partner Ops): Marketplace checklist: need 1:1 and 16:9 tiles, alt text, and a 1500x500 banner. Also need supported regions + SKU codes for Skyline's private offering. I can assemble the marketplace metadata once assets are final.
Emily (Content): Quick question on the brief — can we use the customer quote on p.2? Need opt-in. If not, we should replace with a metrics callout. Also suggest tightening the one-liner to: "Aegis + Skyline: real-time inference at scale"
Maya (Partner Marketing): Thanks all — Jamal ping when mock is up. Marina, what exact wording do you need for logo attribution? Samir, I'll bundle final assets into one ZIP and share. Kai, thanks for sending the SVGs.
Jamal (Design): Mock uploaded: /files/1719551234/hero-mock-3x4-v2.png — adjusted spacing and added alt text suggestion: "Two enterprise platforms integrate to deliver predictable LLM inference" :eyes:
Marina (Legal): Attribution required: "Aegis is a trademark of Aegis Systems. Used with permission." Signed form needed on file. Also: no color modifications to the Aegis mark except approved flat variant.
Aegis PM (Kai): Uploaded: aegis_logos_v2.zip and logo-form-signed.pdf :white_check_mark:
Samir (Partner Ops): I'll draft the marketplace listing and metadata tonight. ETA: tomorrow morning with SKU list and region mapping. :rocket:
Maya (Partner Marketing): :thumbsup: If there are no other blockers, I'll send the final pack to the partner and queue the marketplace publish for next week. Marking this thread as the canonical asset thread — will update when ZIP is posted.
